steps.message: Run monthly table maintenance review on table export.
Load policy and health export; parse 42 input rows (40 surviving after duplicate collapse).
Check autovacuum (incl manual override); compute bloat from dead_pages/total_pages (round-half-up); compute size class from total_pages.
Apply stale cap tightening; check reindex exemptions; apply priority: AUTOVACUUM > BLOAT > STALE > none. Sort by last_analyzed ascending.
Wrote bloat_audit.csv (40 rows), bloat_memo.md (explanatory prose per table), results.json (flagged=27, autovacuum=7, bloat=17, stale=3, compliant=13).
